description: Look up a medical-device manufacturer across 14 official registries (NMPA, EUDAMED, FDA, MHRA, Health Canada, ANVISA, TFDA, MFDS, Roszdravnadzor and more): registration counts, risk-class split and device-level detail. 68,000+ manufacturers; every record re-verified against the manufacturer name. 100 free queries/day; unlimited with a free key.
